name: Maintained by Force
body:
School evocation [force]; Level sorcerer/wizard 6

CAST

Casting Time 1 immediate action
Components V

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target 1 living creature
Duration concentration up to 1 round/level
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You quickly speak the spell and forcibly keep a creature alive by holding their body and soul together using force energy. The target is kept from dying for as long as you concentrate on the spell, though they are still staggered. This spell cannot affect creatures whose body has been destroyed, soul eaten or destroyed, or if the target is reduced to 10 damage per caster level lower than their death threshold. Healing a creature while being kept alive by maintained by force can allow this character to live. If the spell ends while the target is still below their death threshold or was killed by an instant- death spell, they die as normal.
